transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to slow down. Since I stopped working, I'm just... up and moving all day. Going from one little job around the house to the next. It's like I still have a crew waiting on me, but... I don't.
Have you found that you need much less sleep than usual to feel fully rested?
No... not really. I sleep about the same as I always have. I still need my rest.
Did you feel this kind of restlessness or constant worry even before you stopped working?
I don't know. I mean... maybe a little? It's hard to say. I just... I was always busy at work, so I didn't really think about it.
How long ago did you stop working?
About... a year and two months ago. I was doing handyman work. I guess that's when this all became a real problem... after I retired.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of different everyday things, like your family, finances, or health?
I don't know... not really. I mean, I worry about things sometimes, but... just the normal stuff, I guess. Nothing crazy.
Looking back to when you were a child or teenager, did you have trouble sitting still, or were you often told you had too much energy?

Well... that was a long time ago. I guess, yeah, back in grade school, my teachers used to say I was bright, but... scattered. I was always losing my pencils or blurting out answers in class. They always had to remind me to actually finish my work before I could go out for recess. Just normal kid stuff, really.
